coverage_note.sga4: Clean cumulative working reader present for SGA 4.
coverage_note.sga5: Current available SGA 5 segments are assembled as a 133-page clean cumulative reader; this is not treated as a complete volume until audited against the French reference.
coverage_note.sga6: Current available SGA 6 material is assembled as a 231-page clean cumulative reader.
coverage_note.sga7_i: Current SGA 7-I material is assembled as a 106-page clean cumulative reader and a 50-page new continuation packet through Expose IX section 6.6.
coverage_note.proofreading: Working drafts for continuation; not certified final proofread editions.
coverage_note.sga5_high_fidelity_opening: Separate source-checkable French/English supplement for SGA 5 Expose I through section 3.4.5; kept alongside the broader 133-page available-segments reader.
coverage_note.sga5_high_fidelity_expose_i: Separate source-checkable French/English supplement for complete SGA 5 Expose I; kept alongside the broader 133-page available-segments reader. This does not make SGA 5 complete.
coverage_note.sga5_high_fidelity_expose_i_and_appendix: Separate source-checkable French/English supplement for SGA 5 Expose I through the Appendix bibliography; kept alongside the broader available-segments reader. This does not make all of SGA 5 complete.
coverage_note.sga3_existing_english_snapshot: A cleaned rebuild of the existing English SGA 3 translation snapshot is top-level. It removes the most visible code-block/formula-rendering problem, but individual formulas still need later mathematical normalization.
coverage_note.sga5_high_fidelity_strict_restart: Separate source-checkable French/English supplement for SGA 5 scan pages 13-262, printed pages 1-250: Expose I, Appendix bibliography, Expose III, complete Expose III B, and complete Expose V. Next strict source point: Expose VI, scan page 263 / printed page 251.
coverage_note.sga5_high_fidelity_source_checked_editio: Separate source-checkable French/English edition for SGA 5 scan pages 13-496, printed pages 1-484: the strict rebuild is complete through Expose XV and both the terminological and notation indexes.
coverage_note.sga6_strict_source_checked_edition: Separate source-checkable French/English SGA 6 strict edition is active. Current strict SGA 6 coverage is source pages 1-75: Expose 0 plus its appendix through Chapter II sections 1-5. The next continuation point is Chapter II section 6, the Riemann-Roch theorem, beginning at source page 76. The older SGA 6 working draft remains available separately.
